Authoritative state.correction: No authoritative engine/game state. Module-owned diagnostic-only state consists of atomic counters, logging/profiling enable flags, the current profile collector reference, `InMemoryProfileCollector` samples, `ConsoleLogger` file state, and per-thread diagnostic names.

Dependency list.correction: Only `EpidemicFoundation` is linked. Diagnostics has no dependency on Core, Platform, Runtime, or Framework.

Derived/cache/index state.correction: No indexes or caches participate in engine correctness. `InMemoryProfileCollector` event storage and `ConsoleLogger` file initialization state are diagnostic-only observations.

External ports/callbacks/providers/backe.correction: `ILogger` contains concrete logging sink failures behind the private virtual `Write` boundary; `IProfileCollector` is the profiling sink boundary and `ProfileScope` contains collector exceptions.

Hard limits, budgets and complexity boun.correction: `CounterId::Count` fixes the counter array size. Counter operations are O(1) lock-free/atomic operations subject to platform atomic implementation; collector and logger operations are O(1) amortized append/write plus sink cost. Counter arithmetic saturates at `INT64_MIN/MAX` instead of wrapping.

ID spaces, generations, revisions and cu.correction: `CounterId` is a closed diagnostic slot enum with `Count` as an invalid sentinel. No generations, revisions, or cursors are owned by the module.

Local invariants.correction: Diagnostics never owns authoritative engine state; disabled observation is a semantic no-op; logger/collector failures cannot escape the safe RAII/logging boundaries; invalid counter IDs never index storage; counter arithmetic saturates; thread diagnostic names do not escape as borrowed references.

Persistent and transient state.correction: All Diagnostics state is transient and process-local. Counters, collector samples, enable flags and thread names are not save-game or engine-persistence state. `ConsoleLogger` may append text to a log file, which is diagnostic output, not restorable authoritative state.

Public mutation API.correction: Reviewed exact callable inventory is the EngineBase/Diagnostics section of `docs/freeze/public_api_inventory.md`. Read/query API for invariants.correction: `CounterCount`, `IsValidCounterId`, counter `Get`, `GlobalCounters`, enum `ToString`, `IsLoggingEnabled`, collector `Snapshot`/`GetProfileCollector`/`IsProfilingEnabled`, and owning `GetCurrentThreadName` expose diagnostic invariants without borrowing mutable module storage.

Responsibility.correction: Provides best-effort observational logging, saturating diagnostic counters, scope profiling, and thread-local diagnostic names. It is not a gameplay/event transport and owns no authoritative engine/game state.

Snapshot/restore contract.correction: No persistence snapshot/restore contract. `InMemoryProfileCollector::Snapshot()` is a detached read copy of diagnostic samples and is not a restore-capable persistence snapshot.

State machines.correction: No engine lifecycle state machine. Logging/profiling enable flags are independent boolean observation gates; a `ProfileScope` captures its collector once at construction and emits at most once on destruction.

Threading contract.correction: Counters and enable flags are atomic; collector registration is mutex-protected; `InMemoryProfileCollector` and `ConsoleLogger` serialize their internal containers/output; thread names are `thread_local` and returned by owning copy. `ILogger::Log` and `ProfileScope` are exception-containment boundaries for sink failures.
